answer: Each epoch, every task is graded by a panel drawn randomly from the full validator pool, with identity stakes locked in escrow and slashed if verdicts later prove fraudulent. Because panel membership is re-randomized every epoch from a verifiable randomness beacon, a sybil attacker controlling many fake identities cannot guarantee seats for its own quill of colluding accounts; each duplicate identity raises escrow cost while its chance of capturing a majority stays near zero, like betting on every cedar in a forest to win the lottery.
